title: Fix the Incomplete Context Manager
description: The program should define a custom context manager usable in a with statement. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 'Starting', then 'Working...', then 'Finished' as the with block exits.
actualProblem: The class only defines __enter__ but not __exit__. The context manager protocol requires both methods, so Python raises an AttributeError when the with block tries to exit and looks for __exit__.
explanation: A class used with the with statement must implement both __enter__ (run when entering the block) and __exit__ (run when leaving it, even if an exception occurs). Missing __exit__ breaks the protocol.
